content: better-sqlite3 v12.3.0 is the fastest synchronous SQLite driver for Node.js. Supports Node.js 20.x, 22.x, 23.x, 24.x. Synchronous API is ideal for single-user local apps; the synchronous nature is actually an advantage for simplicity here. Not suitable for serverless or multi-threaded environments. Install: npm i better-sqlite3 @types/better-sqlite3
